title: TestRecoverFromShipError_TheFenceKeepsTheDebuggersResolutionOfTheConflictedFile flakes on macOS CI with kept = [] (2 occurrences)
summary: Failed twice on macos-latest go1.23 on 2026-09-29, both times in PRs that never touch core or treefence: train #721 (run 36550234640) and #725 (run 36565868172). The signature both times: 'debugger writable = [shared.md] kept = [], want both [shared.md]', and the cycle still shipped the resolution, so the fence reported nothing kept while nothing was reverted. It passes 30/30 locally on macOS and in the local integration tier. The debugger rewrites a conflicted file to content of a different size, so a racy-git stat cache in writeTreeMode's copied temp index cannot explain it. The likelier reading is an inert fence: Take or writeTree failed at Begin (Outcome.TakeErr set, Kept nil), for example on contention with background git maintenance in a fixture that does not set gittest.MaintenanceConfig, or the snapshot saw an index state the rebase recovery left mid-way. Each occurrence costs a ~12 minute CI rerun.
fix: Reproduce under CI's constraint first (macOS, -race, the package's parallel load): have the fixture record Outcome.TakeErr / RestoreErr and fail with them when set, so the next occurrence names its cause; then fix the cause (the fixture's git config, or the fence's handling of a mid-rebase index) rather than retrying.
acceptance: A failure of this test names the fence's TakeErr/RestoreErr when kept is empty
The root cause is fixed and the test is stable under -count=50 -race on macOS
source: console, 2026-09-29, CI flake classification (second occurrence, CLAUDE.md: 2+ ⇒ regression item)
